content: These references include studies, reviews, and guidelines related to hepatitis D virus (HDV), hepatitis B virus (HBV), and other related topics. Each reference provides the authors, title, journal, year, volume, pages, and sometimes a DOI or URL for access. 1. Pascarella S and Negro F published an updated review on the hepatitis D virus in the journal Liver International in 2011. Their work, spanning pages 7 to 21, provides a comprehensive overview of the virus, including its virology, epidemiology, and clinical implications.
